description: Create a new tag in a space. Requires tagName + spaceId or spaceName.

colorCommand.description: Natural language color command (e.g. 'blue tag'). Overrides tagBg/tagFg.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: create_space_tag
